title: John Lennon and Yoko Ono give multiple interviews | 1971
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono gave a number of interviews on 15 October 1971.

They invited several reporters into their suite at the St Regis Hotel in New York City, including David Wigg of The Daily Express, Takihiko Iimura from Japanese art journal Bijutsu Techo, Tom Zito of The Washington Post, and Emily Wasserman from Artforum magazine.
